description: Which source domains AI answer engines cite, by buyer category and question shape, from the Machine Relations Index.

interface.shortDescription: Which sources AI answer engines cite, by category
interface.longDescription: Query the Machine Relations Index, a neutral public measurement of which source domains ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity cite when buyers ask questions. Get the ranked sources cited for a category and question shape, or how often a given site is cited and by which engines. Read-only, no account, CC BY 4.0 data.
defaultPrompt: Which publications do AI answer engines cite most for cybersecurity tools?
How often do ChatGPT and Perplexity cite techcrunch.com, and for which categories?
